name: STIHL MS 880
blurb: Every bar is .063″ gauge: one 21″ bar on 3/8″ chain (75 links), and .404″ chain from 25″ to 59″ (80–173 links), per STIHL's chain-selection chart.
intro: The MS 880 (and the MS 880 R) runs .063″ gauge on every bar STIHL lists for it, but two pitches. STIHL's selection chart gives the saw one 3/8″ setup, a 21″ bar on 36 RS3 chain with 75 drive links, and eight .404″ setups on 46 RS chain, from a 25″ bar (80 links) to a 59″ bar (173 links). Two bar lengths come in two versions: at 36″ the exchangeable-nose (RS) bar takes 108 links and the DUROMATIC bar takes 104, while at 41″ both take 123. So read the drive-link count off your own bar stamp, or count the old loop, rather than going by length. A move between 3/8″ and .404″ also needs the matching drive sprocket on the saw. STIHL offers no green-labeled low-kickback chain in .404″, and nearly every bar in this block is yellow-labeled, so STIHL's chart recommends 3/8″ sprockets with green-labeled chain and bars wherever possible. The current MS 881 is not on this 2017 chart, so this page does not cover it.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 36 RS3 75 with recommended bar 3002 000 9123. Exchangeable-nose (RS) bar with a 10-tooth nose sprocket; the only 3/8″ setup in the MS 880 block.

STIHL's chart lists chain 46 RS 80 with recommended bar 3002 000 9731. RS bar, 12-tooth nose. STIHL marks this bar with an asterisk: no green-labeled reduced-kickback bar is offered at this length, so the chart lists a yellow-labeled bar. STIHL offers no green-labeled low-kickback chain in .404″, so the chart lists a yellow-labeled chain.

STIHL's chart lists chain 46 RS 91 with recommended bar 3002 000 9741. RS bar. STIHL marks this bar with an asterisk: no green-labeled reduced-kickback bar is offered at this length, so the chart lists a yellow-labeled bar. STIHL offers no green-labeled low-kickback chain in .404″, so the chart lists a yellow-labeled chain.

STIHL's chart lists chain 46 RS 108 with recommended bar 3002 000 9753. Exchangeable-nose (RS) bar: 108 links, four more than the 36″ DUROMATIC bar. STIHL marks this bar with an asterisk: no green-labeled reduced-kickback bar is offered at this length, so the chart lists a yellow-labeled bar. STIHL offers no green-labeled low-kickback chain in .404″, so the chart lists a yellow-labeled chain.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 46 RS 173 with recommended bar 3002 000 9576. RS bar; the longest bar on STIHL's chart. The chain carries STIHL's triple-asterisk note: read the yellow warning information supplied with the bars and chains that fit the 088 / MS 880 powerhead.

STIHL's chart lists chain 46 RS 104 with recommended bar 3002 001 8052. STIHL DUROMATIC bar (type D in the chart): 104 links, four fewer than the 36″ RS bar. STIHL marks this bar with an asterisk: no green-labeled reduced-kickback bar is offered at this length, so the chart lists a yellow-labeled bar. STIHL offers no green-labeled low-kickback chain in .404″, so the chart lists a yellow-labeled chain.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 46 RS 123 with recommended bar 3002 000 8058. STIHL DUROMATIC bar; same 123-link loop as the 41″ RS bar. STIHL marks this bar with an asterisk: no green-labeled reduced-kickback bar is offered at this length, so the chart lists a yellow-labeled bar.
